ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to restrict editing of the CTX Attorney fields that are updated through the Update_Attorneys ADF pipeline.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Attorney", PRIORVALUE(Contact_Source_Description__c) = "CashTrax User", $User.Alias != "apionly", OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(AccountId))), AccountId != PRIORVALUE(AccountId) ), ISCHANGED(LastName), ISCHANGED(FirstName), ISCHANGED(MiddleName__c), ISCHANGED(kw__Nickname__c), ISCHANGED(Phone), ISCHANGED(BarVerificationDate__c), ISCHANGED(BarVerificationExpirationDate__c), ISCHANGED(Fax), ISCHANGED(Email), ISCHANGED(Phone_Extension__c), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), ISCHANGED(Title), ISCHANGED(LastDateFunded__c), ISCHANGED(DateFundedPlus7days__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only API Only Users are permitted to edit these fields on CashTrax Attorney records.
